name: cobol-header-resync-area-a-local
body: header_at ends a period-less sentence at a fixed-layout procedure name plus period, or section header, in area A, at a free-layout section header, or never for a file with no recorded layout; it skips a token repeating the previous token's origin. Area A is a local 8..=11 constant duplicating format.rs. Limit: a statement's last word in area A followed by a period splits there, and the two area-A definitions can drift. Upgrade by sharing format.rs's constant, or narrowing the split if a corpus shows false headers.
